provenance.map_selection: MapSelect passes gUnk_09EE4BB0 to SetBgMapBlocks with 1 by 2 blocks. The cursor index is explicitly cycled through 0..4 and its row is XORed with 1, proving the separate s16[5] and s16[2] coordinate arrays. func_08093E34 loops i from a to a+9 and indexes gUnk_09EE4BE0[i-a], proving ten u16 tile destinations. The WORLDSELECT Mode is independently identified by its exact ASCII name and the unique ordered triple WORLDSELECT_0/1/2 callbacks in each native ROM.
provenance.native_selection_catalog: The existing MapSelect resource pointers, cursor coordinates and EU language selectors form one native initialized-data prefix: 22 bytes in US/JP and 84 bytes in EU, including the native two-byte pointer-alignment gap in EU. Complete definitions are ordered by their original regional positions without changing types, bounds, initializer tokens or regional presence. The EU five-entry tile-size table is read only as a scalar LoadObjTiles argument and is reconstructed as const, yielding its existing 10-byte readonly span. The ten-entry tile-destination table remains explicitly placed because the owning MapSelect TaskDesc interrupts the initialized-data run; no callback metadata is moved to this catalog merely to close that gap. All existing object contracts and payloads are retained, and no new translation-unit boundary is claimed.
